person.name: Pedro Morago López-Vázquez
person.description: Senior QA Engineer with 5 years of test automation and a Mathematics degree, working on API, backend and E2E testing, CI tooling and the evaluation of quantitative and AI-driven systems.
person.credential: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) v4.0

hero.name: Pedro Morago
hero.text: Five years in test strategy, API testing and end-to-end automation, with software teams in cybersecurity, field services and telecom. My background combines mathematics (BSc, University of Cantabria) and formal test design (ISTQB CTFL v4.0), which I apply to deciding what to test, at which layer and how to automate it.
hero.photoAlt: Pedro Morago, arms crossed, in a navy shirt

work.title: Portfolio
work.lede: Products and tools I've built and tested. Each one opens into the full story.

groups.title: QA engineering and tools
groups.note: From my day-to-day QA work, and the tools I built around it.

projects.title: CI Pipeline Optimization
projects.summary: A Python optimization model showed 4 CI containers would beat 7: about 8% faster and 41% cheaper.

projects.title: Screen Recorder (QA mode)
projects.summary: Turns a bug into evidence: video, console, network and every step.

projects.title: CI Shard Advisor
projects.summary: A mathematical optimization problem hidden inside a test pipeline.

projects.title: QA Wiki
projects.summary: A public QA knowledge base with more than 50 articles.

groups.title: Quantitative and real-time labs
groups.note: Personal projects on systems that are hard to test: numerical solvers, real-time state, model evaluation and a full-stack product of my own. Each repository is public, with its tests and CI.

projects.title: Spin Trainer
projects.summary: A full-stack training app of my own, from idea to release, tested like production: 145 API tests, 37 Playwright specs and 8 real defects found.

projects.title: Game Integrity Lab
projects.summary: Evaluating cheat-detection models on synthetic data, where the best model's false positives all fell on strong, legitimate players.

projects.title: Solver Validation Lab
projects.summary: Testing numbers nobody can check by hand: an exact equity engine, a strategy validator and push/fold solvers checked by best responses.

projects.title: Real-Time Testbed
projects.summary: A WebSocket game server that crashed and restored 619 times in one run, with every client converging.
